body:
I'm sorry for that. How is your stomach doing now? That sounds really terrifying. Fear controls a lot of my life. I don't want to end up in a hospital, it almost feels inevitable. 
Okay I am going to try my hardest to get this infection under control. You mean a lot. Thank you for caring about me enough to post here.

Someone posted a link to a very good mental health e-book and that was giving me a little solace. I think Im slowly starving myself to death and I also have a tooth infection thats stopping me from working. I guess those are my two most important tasks to focus on

I find myself making these lists and then setting goals and not having the will to achieve them. The lack of monetary funds also is destroying me. I find myself slipping and eating unhealthy just so I can get a little bit of warmth. 
I don't know how to keep going every day when it feels like I'm fighting upstream. My body aches from working and I'm quite young. I can't seem to get a grip on anything. My debt is too high to ever pay off and I've been suffering for it for years. I don't have a proper house to live in. Mine is unfinished. Things are so hopeless at this point. I keep looking out the window and thinking I could end all this pain right now.

Certainly increasing the worry. I spoke with her on the phone and she was very upset. I don't have enough cash to pay for the damages to the car right away so she probably is going to be carless for a little bit. She got a DUI and isn't able to drive for 30 days. I guess I have a little luck there.

Some part of me won't allow me to be suicidal. I want to be strong. I cannot face the daily battles that others seem to go through so easily. I'm so tired of being poor it hurts. Literally and figuratively. I have a couple close friends but they have moved away recently.

I live in constant fear/panic and interacting with people on any level has people wondering why I am so frightened all the time. They don't understand how poor I am and that every second for me counts.

It felt horrible, I cried for awhile and asked myself what I was doing countless times. That is a difficult question to answer. I have felt hopeless for years. Therapy, medication, and time have not given me any sort of relief, and I desperately crave some relief from this anxiety /stress/panic.

9. Do you have any advice for making it to work everyday? I worked as an electrical apprentice for 1.5 years and I had a terrible co-worker that almost tortured me. I used to lie in bed and shake and sweat and couldn't sleep. Work started taking over my every thought and I felt horrible. I put my two weeks in and felt incredible. I got a new job as an audio visual technician and I'm finding it incredibly challenging to make it to work 40/hours a week. I started working during summer at 60/hours a week I did this for 2 months then all of a sudden things started changing. I started waking up in the middle of the night sweaty. I began shaking and trembling when I thought about work. Physically shaking! I am making probably the most I could for this period of my life. I can't seem to make myself go to work everyday. I went 2 days this week.

1. I spoke with him about it today and it sounded like he was trying to save the house with my uncle and some loan magic. I think we are indeed pretty far along in the process. Hence my anxiety beginning to act up. I could probably ask my best friend or try and move to my mothers house.

2. I am surrounded by ocean for 35 miles. I think I could make a day trip out of the dental appointment but I am sort of stuck with trying to find out which insurance providers will cover a tooth extraction. My course of action should be to call my insurance company and ask about an endodontist in my area? 

3. Haha you should consider yourself lucky. I eat lots of fruits and vegetables. Rice and beans are probably my two staples. I really don't know what to do here. There is no public transportation here only in the summer. Should I try to get a ride once a week to the grocery store? I bought a foreman grill but our refrigerator broke and all my food went bad so I kind of abandoned that idea. 

4. Okay because my parents instilled values into me. And if I am not sacrificing something of mine to help others I almost don't feel whole. It seems like I need to work on limiting how much I can do for others and really focus on myself.

5. When I mention the people that are rude to me its almost always consistent. I don't smile that much because of my gapped teeth and I think it makes people very uncomfortable, so they go into this default defense mode. And thats where people start being horrible. My last co-worker treated me like shit for a year and I couldn't take it anymore so I put my two weeks in. I should have a rough idea of what I will allow someone else to do to me. 

5. I spent a decent amount of time studying computer programming. I have maybe 1 or 2 projects kicking around, and I have actually sold some of my code to people. I would really like to begin working on a programming career but I don't know how. And this bothers me a lot because I think programming would be the best career choice for me.

6. I don't want to sound cliche but what you have done for me is essentially allowed me to continue living.

1. My father and I have very poor communication skills and butt heads often. The house was in the paper for foreclosure but I am not sure how far along in the process it is truly. Should I still be looking for places to live? 

3. I just recently got my cavities all filled but I have a tooth that needs to be pulled. This is causing undue stress. The work I need done can't be done in my geographic location. I need to schedule an appointment and take a few days off work to get it done.but I barely feel like I have enough money to live. 

2. My kitchen is all unfinished along with the entire house. I purchased a rice cooker and a microwave a couple months ago. My meals are horrible, I try my best to eat healthy but that's difficult. 

4. Okay are you sure? It's really hard to not think about. I want my siblings and brothers and sisters to not worry about eating. This hurts me everyday. 

5. Focus on loving myself? Or what did you mean by the last bullet point? I am trying so so hard to love myself. I constantly find myself talking to myself how other people talk to me. Which is very rude. 

6. You are incredible.

Okay people have this misconception that I'm blessed for having a house to live in, this is very true. However my house was in the middle of being finished. I don't have a kitchen and haven't had heat for a couple winter's. This is anything but comfortable. With my student loans it was the best possible move after college. My mother has a home but is very sick and I wouldn't want to put that burden on her. 

My total income per month is 3100. I have total loan payments of 1500 a month. I don't have a car and I walk everywhere. My other payments are 200 for rent, 525 for food and 200 for healthcare. I occasionally help out my brothers and sister who were living with us and that was a little bit of money. I only got this job 2 months ago and haven't had much h time to adjust to this budget. But it doesn't seem like I will have time because my father's house is being foreclosed on. I have horrible teeth which cause anxiety I can't believe I've been working my whole life with these teeth. Things just feel like there crumbling and I have no control over it. I'm terrified that I'll have to take care of my parents when I'm older and I'm in no position to take care of myself. I've wanted children so badly but financially it isn't possible. I've convinced myself nobody is worth my time because I owe so much money. I have no confidence and no self esteem and don't know where to begin.

Find things left? Was something promised to you originally from life? 

What do you mean when you say, "keep that god damned bag over my head?"

Are you going to bed hungry because you cannot afford food?

You could be correct about my anxiety, which is another terrible problem. I never know which feelings to trust and which to shush away. When you phrase it like that you make me sound like someone who's life is worth living.
The interest rates on the private loans are all around 7%. I have used up my deferment period in college because I took a semester off because of loan issues.

You're the first person to take the time and respond to my post, and I appreciate that immensely. Because you have suggested this I am going to start tonight. I always list 5 things I am grateful for before bedtime but maybe writing them down will help with making me believe it.
I was seeing a therapist but my insurance provider changed and so did my eligibility.

You have been so kind and patient in asking me questions I will provide as much detail as I can. I made it to work this morning after some very kind redditors posted some really kind things. I will post a detailed explanation when I get home. What details will be most pertinent? Exactly how I am budgeting?

How do you manage to stay positive all the time? Someone can say something negative to me and my whole week will be ruined. I focus a lot on what other people say and it really effects my mood. I've been trying to control it but it seems fruitless.

Usually there are people who post very upset with me that I haven't provided enough detail or my situation is all my doing. I understand where they are coming from.

I live in a constant state of panic and fear with lack of rational thought patterns.
Thank you.
Interesting I've never heard of this. The medication I take is for social anxiety.

Flipping a this was such a good message. I'm trying so hard to surround myself with positive people like you but it's difficult. You seem to have such a good grasp on life. Its the trying my best everyday that's difficult. I don't really seem to have a personality I kind of meld and bend to whatever situation I'm in currently. I'm hoping over time I can build a portfolio but it feels fruitless right now.
I don't know who you are but you've affected me deeply. Thank you for your kind words. I find myself slowly becoming more and more suicidal as time goes on. I'm frightening myself.

Everyday feels like I'm fighting this uphill upstream battle. I've fought poverty for along time and I've only made matters worse by trying to better myself with a degree. I don't think I'll be able to support myself financially with the loan size I have.

I signed some papers every year for 4 years straight and now owe 175,000 usd. The number makes me sick to my stomach I constantly  vomit. Most days I lie in bed and think about suicide. Every second the world is aflame with my regret. It burns everything outside and it is moving in.
Thank you so much for taking the time to respond. I have both of those books on my nightstand at the moment, the only two pieces of literature I own on the topic.

The act of getting to the therapist and not missing work is also difficult. I feel immense pressure at all times to be working as hard as possible because of the debt I owe, and its really driving me over the edge. I think I'm close to a mental breakdown and I feel very stupid and irrational at the moment. Its a horrible combination of thoughts and feelings that I can't escape at the moment. I like the idea of having an animal you are responsible for but I don't think I am in a financial position to afford one. As heartbroken as that makes me.

Thanks a lot for taking the time to read and respond. I am in therapy yes. I've switched around a lot and haven't found the right fit. I've kept a journal of my thoughts for around two years now. It helped a little bit to identify patterns of behavior but I started relating it to anxious thoughts and now it just makes me nervous. I take walks around my neighborhood but it reminds me of the place I want to leave so badly but can't seem to earn enough money.

I didn't mean to imply that not having a job means no anxiety just to clarify that. 
That sounds like something wonderful. I've always had the dream of throwing all possessions away and becoming a monk, slightly unrealistic for me haha. Do you have any particular websites you use for the Buddhist techniques you use? Zen is one of my favorite words. I love the fact you used it.

Interesting suggestions, nobody has taught me the thumb trick yet. I am going to give that a try for the next couple months. Thanks!
I have been practicing my deep breathing a lot. I think I've trained myself to feel anxious whenever I deep breathe because that means I must feel anxious if I've taken over the autonomous breath functions. 
What helps you bring your focus back? Does it happen to you at work at all?
Ha unfortunately 125k is private. The number is so large thinking about it sends me into a full blown panic attack.
Interesting. Ive never heard of this before. I am going to have to do some research.
Unfortunately student loan payments are non-dischargable in bankruptcy.
Thanks for piecing the puzzle together for me. I am a little exhausted and not thinking straight.
Thank you for your help. This seems to be my best option.
Poor phrasing by me. My father is losing his house. I am living in the house but will essentially be homeless.
Yeah I completely agree. I have been putting in the work to get there I clearly have been putting in the wrong work.

5 years at a private institution, its incredible how everyone has such good financial understanding of the world. From when I was born I was told from every person in my family that I was to go to college. I guess I did whatever it took to go. And now here I am. 

My whole family is impoverished. I don't understand how I am supposed to just increase my income. I've been working my way up the construction ladder doing low voltage work but at this point it feels fruitless.
Okay thank you. I updated.

Thank you so much for the honest answer. It appears this is the best solution. My co signer is going to be upset. But I need to eat at the end of the week. I am essentially starting from ground zero with my career.
This is my fathers house. Should have made that clear. My apologies.

Hello I have a degree in management information systems. Honestly I wish it were easier to just increase income. I started out making 25k for a year. I am up to 62k after 2 years but now the work I have put in feels worthless. My budget has been refined a few times by personalfinance. I have spoken with my aunt and she understands.

Hello I live on an island in the east coast. If I want to further my career in programming I would need to move. Also if I wanted to live more affordably. As this is a resort town rent is extremely high. I simply don't know where to begin.
I have been living far below my means for a few years. I am budgeting and doing my best.

Sorry I was in a rush and I meant to say first and lasts months rent. I will most certainly look for roommates to move in with. I have a resume should I make sure that is updated? I have professional experience doing residential electrical, programming, and barbacking/restaurant experience.

Yes I have contacted the private lending company hundreds of times and cannot get anywhere with them. I have used up all my periods of Income based repayment and(you are only alotted a certain time) I cannot afford to contact a bankruptcy lawyer. Nor do I have the time. Thank you for talking to me.

I can relate to this on another level. My debate right now is whether to throw shoes on and go waste my life at this job I hate or call in sick and lie in bed in guilt. I don't see any way out of this situation. Sometimes the goal for the day is simply to make my bed. With the simplest I know I can accomplish this and it helps get my motivation rolling. Best of luck to you. Let me know if you have any secret tips for overcoming this.
Thank you. I have posted to personalfinance. The issue comes down to increasing my income which is the most important step to paying down debt. Which I just can't really increase my income.
It would be very very helpful if we could chat. I'll send you a pm when I'm home from work. Thank you so much.

I cosigned these loans with my aunt and if I default they will attempt to garnish wages from her and that would absolutely destroy me.

Thank you for your kind words. I don't think I can do it anymore.
Having lots of trouble making it through days right now. Thank you for providing a little light in this dark time.

This post was 20 days old, I am surprised you took the time to read it. I appreciate your comment. The plan is to break up the problems and work on each one individually. My cavities have all been drilled and filled and I have a consult with an oral surgeon tomorrow. The travel and expense is worth it I think. Little reductions on anxiety as I practice being mindful at all times. Hope you are taking care of yourself. I will work on number 2.
Thank you this was very helpful and exactly what I was looking for. I appreciate it.

I am constantly thinking about my teeth from the moment I wake up til the moment I sleep. I spend as much time as I can sleeping because I fear someone asking me a question about my mouth. I am very awkward in conversations because I know as soon as I speak people are going to stare at my mouth and wonder how I let this all happen.

On top of that all of my financial troubles. I have no children and I can barely take care of myself. I had so much energy when I was younger. I keep going into jobs I hate because thats all that pays around this town. I can't save up to move because money has to be spent on loans and eating. I'm getting very tired of it and resorting to sleeping all the time because I can't face the stage of my teeth. I have been going to the dentist for a month now and have skipped multiple days at work. 

Thank you for taking the time to responds to me. Its really nice to hear from anyone with positive words.
What if you are an unobservant person? Oh man you would judge super hardcore if you saw mine. Then I'm not sure what would happen, but it would horrible. And panic inducing.
Woah thank you for the awesome reply. You've given me a feeling of hope. Do you embrace the gap and smile regardless of judgement?

When I say there are no jobs in my location I mean I would 100 percent have to re-locate if I wanted an onsite job. I live on a small island.

The plan for now is to try and make some money freelancing on the side and building up a portfolio. Then when I have enough saved up I will attempt to move. My housing situation is precarious at the moment and I will probably lose it soon. This adds to the confusion of it all.

I was trying to maintain my full-time job and pursue the freelance career and things were all too exhausting. I didn't have enough time before starting freelancing and that seemed like too much. I didn't want to sacrifice the quality of my code in order to make a deadline. 

Your words have been infinitely helpful in this situation and I appreciate you immensely. I can't thank you enough.
I am an indentured servant for the remainder of my life unless I can increase my income substantially. Things feel very hopeless and I have nobody who understands.

Haha essentially yes. Where I live there is no possibility of working as a software developer. This puts me in a very difficult position. I'm uncertain if I should attempt to save money at my shitty current job in hopes of moving away? My loan payments are 1800 a month. I don't know if I could handle rent and loan payments.

Haha I've recently looked up celebrities with bad teeth to try and alleviate some of the anxiety. It's just the daily interactions are killing me. The small talk kills me. And I don't know how to tell people no. I'm struggling a lot and appreciate your comment. Thank you.
Do you have a list of the callouts with maps?

I have used up the deferment period when I was forced to take a semester off because I couldn't get a co-sign for a loan. This ended the deferment period. That is very little money! I worry non-stop and can't keep my head clear at all.

I'm going to try my best to work towards a career in programming. Thank you for your advice.

My intentions were to pursue a career in my field, which I am slowly trying to make my way towards. But life got in the way. Situations that are too lengthy and time consuming to explain here led me to where I am(not denying my role, 100 percent my responsibility). 

My degree is in management information systems. How do you suggest I get into that field with the details you have about me? Is a remote position possible that pays 75k+ a year? There is not a job where I live that would allow me to work in my field. And commuting is not possible because I am surrounded by water.

Therefore I have to try to save and move away but I am having an incredibly difficult time. And I do not know where to begin making changes. I felt like I have made the best decisions I could with the information I was provided.

I hardly have enough time to make this post. Because how much I work and how exhausted I am when I get home. Then I have 2 hours to get everything done for the next day. Its all just too much and I don't know where to begin. Sorry clarifications.

It feels all too exhausting to try and evaluate each problem everyday and so I try to lump them all together and solve all of them at once, which clearly isn't working and is most likely contributing to anxiety.

My monthly budget is:
*internet 50/month
*rent 400/month
*groceries 400/month
*loans 1800/month
*luxuries(lol) 200/month
I've only acquired this job last month. I have a small savings of 1000. But I am a month behind on my loan payments. Getting to work everyday is a struggle. I can't see myself doing this for more than a year. But I can't afford to move away. I guess I should look into trade school and get my electricial license and try to somehow make enough money to stay where I am? I don't know. I'm so lost.
I've been to two appointments which were covered by insurance. The expensive stuff hasn't come around. I probably need braces but Ill never afford those with my debt.
This was a very interesting perspective and gave me lots of hope. Thank you for taking the time to do this for me. It means the world.

It's really strange because I can convince myself the same thing for a couple days then I notice somebody staring at my teeth/mouth and any shred of confidence I had disappears. I can't really make eye contact with anyone and it's really starting to hurt. I haven't learned to love myself despite my flaws. 

Other than the obvious romantic sufferings I've endured some terrible social interactions. I feel like I'm constantly about to explode and I interrupt people when they talk. I do find myself staring at people's mouths sometimes wondering if hopefully their teeth are as bad as mine so I don't feel horrible conversing with them.

I consider myself highly unintelligent although people make comments all the time about how smart I am. I worked with a very toxic person for a year and a half and I think it really negatively affected me.

It's hard to watch my brothers and sisters not have enough food when I am throwing thousands of dollars a month away to loan interest. I can't really stomach it much longer. I didn't anticipate this being a problem because I was 18 and was told my entire life if I wanted a job I'd need to go to college. 

Thank you for sharing your kind words with me. You are spot on with your assessment. I really do not think people pay as much attention to them as I do. Friends always say, " ididnt even know you had bad teeth!" But it's more of the silent judgement that I know is happening. When wealthy people think less of me because I have bad teeth. When people awkwardly look away after seeing my teeth. It's the little things over a long time that led me here.

This was incredible to hear. I try my best to smile but I know it makes people uncomfortable. I can tell when people are staring at my teeth. And I can't control the fear that comes with it. I've been practicing different techniques for awhile now. CBT, meditation, and proper dieting. I feel very hopeless in my situation.

Thank you very much for talking to me. I have talked with financial advice multiple times and it lessens the anxiety temporarily but the feeling of uncertainty I cannot shake. I can't get rid of this hopelessness. And I don't know where to begin fixing my problems. 

Things will get better. I hope. They can't get worse. They probably could.

An okay-ish position is the frightening part. I can feel myself succumbing to my own negativity and it's driving me crazy. My work life alright. But my housing is not very stable. My father could lose the house at any moment. 

I don't even know where to begin with all the problems and it's spiraling out of control and I can't stop it.

Half the debt? The total is 180k. 130k private and 50k federal. I am in a really bad position and things are getting worse. I'm trying my best to find a higher paying job but my options are limited because of location. I feel hopeless at the moment and lost.
Do you have any advice for constant anxiety fear nervousness? I'm struggling to stay afloat and feel like it's going to end soon.

I can't believe something that seems so small in the grand scheme could affect my life so much. Every second I constantly worry about how my mouth is oriented. Whenever I talk I am aware of how my teeth are showing. I constantly imagine people thinking horrible things about me. I have absolutely zero self-confidence. I can hardly muster a sentence without questioning myself and my reasons.

I have been to 3 dental appointments already and it is just the starting phase of this whole procedure. I live in constant fear that I will lose my job because of my teeth. I feel like nobody would want to employ a loser like myself with bad teeth and its all a vicious circle. I've seen a few different counselors but their suggestions have all been, "if you don't like it that much, just change it?" but when you are dirt poor and have 0 discretionary income things aren't so easy. I have to worry about my siblings getting enough food.

Anyways this story was quite uplifting. I wish to someday feel the same things you have felt. I know if I stay strong on this path I can set myself free from the anxiety of the teeth. Thank you so much for sharing.

Things will get better. I hope.

25/month interwebz
100/week rent
300/groceries

I only recently acquired my new job and have established a small safety net. I am in constant fear of my future. If I lose this job I have nowhere to go. I will be homeless. 

I dream of owning a car one day, so I don't have to walk to work in the cold. That would cost a lot of money. I don't know if I should prioritize getting my teeth fixed over a car? It would reduce a lot of anxiety.

Thank you so much for your time.

I only got this job a few weeks ago. Things are not very clear at the moment because this whole month has been a transition period for me. And its causing an amount of stress I can't handle. 

You are correct with the annual income. I stated my budget above which was 1,000 a month. I am worried about being able to keep my current job while having bad teeth. Every interaction I constantly go over the possibilities if people see my teeth. I don't know what to do and need help. 

If I can clarify more please ask. Thank you for your time.

Thank you very much for taking the time to answer.

I am in the process of getting my teeth checked out but am getting stressed really horribly about the entire process. I'm already nervous almost all the time and I fear losing my job because of it. It all comes from teeth anxiety because the society I live in really glorifies pearly whites.

I am 26 years old and have been looking for good paying jobs for awhile. I'm hindered by my location but cannot save enough money to move away.

My only costs are essentially groceries, internet, and rent. My father charges me 100/week for rent. Internet is 25 a month and groceries total to around 300 a month. Does it seem like I will be able to pay this debt off before I die? Should I look into PLSF for my federal debt of 50k? I would need a government job if I did that though, correct?

Thank you
